es: Escribir un diario de una semana en el extranjero con bloques léxicos, expresiones coloquiales y una estrategia de comunicación.

teaching.en: Monday: I landed in Dublin, and to be honest, I was completely beat.
teaching.es: Lunes: aterricé en Dublín y, para ser sincero, estaba completamente agotado.
teaching.explanationEs: El diario abre con el día, un hecho en pasado y un bloque (to be honest) con una expresión coloquial (beat).

teaching.explanationEs: Estrategia de comunicación: I didn't catch that pide que lo repitan sin hacer sentir mal a nadie.

prompt.es: No entiendes lo que te dice alguien. ¿Qué frase es la estrategia adecuada?

choices.text: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you rephrase it?
Speak English, please, I no understand.

feedback.es: La estrategia correcta es cortés y gramatical: disculpa, no captaste y pides decirlo de otra forma.

hint.es: Busca la frase cortés y gramaticalmente correcta.

prompt.es: Completa: «Logré arreglar mi tarjeta del banco.»

feedback.es: Manage + to + verbo expresa que lograste hacer algo con esfuerzo.

hint.es: Es el verbo que significa «lograr» y lleva to + verbo.

origin.audio: Day three. It was pretty hard. I couldn't figure out the timetable, so I asked a driver to rephrase what he said. To be fair, he was very patient.

prompt.es: Elige la frase del diario con un bloque y una expresión coloquial bien usados.

choices.text: To be honest, I was beat after the flight.
To be honest, I was beating after the flight.
To be honest, I was beat after flight.

feedback.es: Beat significa agotado; beating no expresa cansancio y, además, flight necesita el artículo.

prompt.es: Escribe tu diario de la semana en Dublín, con bloques, jerga y estrategia.

answer.text: Monday: I landed in Dublin, and to be honest, I was completely beat. The taxi driver talked so fast that I said, «Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?» and he laughed and repeated it slowly. Tuesday: The thing is, my room is tiny and cramped, and I'm swamped with forms and emails. Bummer! Wednesday: I couldn't figure out the bus map, so I asked a driver to rephrase what he said. To be fair, he was very kind, and he showed me the right stop. Thursday: My landlord was pretty cold at first, but it's not like he is a bad man; he just works a lot. Friday: I managed to sort out my bank card, and that was awesome. Saturday: It rained all day, so I stayed in and wrote my diary. No worries, next week will be easier!

Monday: I landed in Dublin last night, and I was beat. On the bus, nobody slowed down, so I said, «Sorry, I didn't catch that,» and a woman repeated everything slowly. Tuesday: To be honest, the room is pretty cramped, and I'm swamped with paperwork for the university. Wednesday: The thing is, I couldn't figure out the timetable, so I asked a driver to rephrase it, and he was very patient. Thursday: The landlord was cold, but to be fair, I arrived very late. Friday: I managed to sort out my bank card, which was awesome. Saturday: Bummer, it rained all day, so I stayed in, wrote my diary and called my mum. No worries, it was a good first week.

feedback.es: Un buen diario cuenta los días en pasado, reparte bloques y expresiones coloquiales con moderación, e incluye una frase para pedir aclaración.

origin.text: Escribe el diario de tu primera semana en Dublín (entre 120 y 200 palabras, de lunes a sábado): llegada, un malentendido, un problema de alojamiento y un día genial. Incluye dos bloques (the thing is, to be honest, to be fair, it's not like), dos expresiones coloquiales (beat, swamped, bummer, awesome) y una estrategia de comunicación (I didn't catch that / Could you rephrase that?).

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué opina la hablante del casero.

choices.text: He was rude and refused to help.
He was cold at first but then helpful.
He was very friendly from the start.

feedback.es: La hablante lo describe como frío al principio, pero reconoce que luego le dio una llave de repuesto.

origin.audio: Day four. My landlord was pretty cold, but to be fair, it's not like he knew I was arriving late. Anyway, he gave me a spare key, and I slept very well.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase pide aclaración con la gramática correcta?

choices.text: Could you rephrase me that, please?
Could you to rephrase that, please?

feedback.es: Rephrase va sin complemento de persona y tras could va el verbo base sin to.

prompt.es: Completa: «Siendo justos, el conductor fue muy amable.»

feedback.es: To be fair concede un punto a favor de otra persona dentro del diario.

prompt.es: ¿Qué entrada de diario usa un tono coloquial y natural?

choices.text: I'm swamped, but it's not like I'm complaining.
I am very busy, although I do not wish to complain.
Swamped am I, but not complaining I am.

feedback.es: En un diario personal encajan el tono coloquial y las contracciones; la versión rígida es demasiado formal y la otra tiene el orden roto.

prompt.es: Escribe una frase para pedir que te lo repitan más despacio.

answer.text: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again more slowly?
accepted: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again more slowly?
Sorry, I didn't get that. Could you repeat it more slowly?

feedback.es: Una petición cortés se disculpa, dice que no captó y pide repetirlo con Could you.

origin.text: No has entendido a un compañero. Pídele con cortesía que lo repita más despacio.
